seljuk.definition:
n any one of the Turkish dynasties that ruled Asia Minor from the 11th to the 13th centuries; they successfully invaded Byzantium and defended the Holy Land against Crusaders
a of or relating to the Seljuks
seljuk.translation: (土耳其的)塞尔柱王朝, 塞尔柱朝君主[臣民]

seljukian.definition:
a. Of or pertaining to Seljuk, a Tartar chief who embraced
   Mohammedanism, and began the subjection of Western Asia to that faith
   and rule; of or pertaining to the dynasty founded by him, or the empire
   maintained by his descendants from the 10th to the 13th century.
seljukian.translation: 赛尔柱王朝的, 塞尔柱王朝时代人的

seljuks.definition:
plural of Seljuk
n any one of the Turkish dynasties that ruled Asia Minor from the 11th to the 13th centuries; they successfully invaded Byzantium and defended the Holy Land against Crusaders
a of or relating to the Seljuks
seljuks.translation: (Seljuk 的复数) (土耳其的)塞尔柱王朝, 塞尔柱朝君主[臣民]
